name: Eastone Century Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Eastone Century Technology Co.,Ltd. provides communication network technology services and system solutions to telecom operators and equipment manufacturers in China. The company provides communication network engineering, communication network maintenance, and communication network optimization services; value-added service platforms and applications for operators and government and enterprise customers; network hardware products; production of network equipment; internet of things business platform operations; end-to-end internet of things solutions based on the internet of things platform; tag analytics big data services; and communications big data business identification services. It also offers IoT products; and big data solutions, such as Yitong credit card anti-theft system, Yitongai tourism big data platform, IoT end-to-end quality business analysis platform, and home collector battle map products. In addition, the company provides 5G fronthaul solutions, GPS-Beidou dual-star clock synchronization router, and low-cost solution for 5G indoor distribution transformation; and industry solution, including oil engine monitoring system, smart campus class sign solution, smart canteen system solution, smart construction site products, smart prison safety production solutions, and Yitong century smart sewing solution. Further, it is involved in the provision of labor dispatch, engineering construction, human resources, investment and management, technology promotion and application, software technology and network, software and IT, information transmission, equity investment, investment management, and asset management services; intelligent control; system integration; power generation, power transmission, and computing power and new energy businesses; and power supply activities. The company was formerly known as Guangdong Eastone Century Technology Co.,Ltd. Eastone Century Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
